figurative_meaning_bn: শত্রুকে তিনটি দ্রব্য দেওয়ার ভাবনা থেকে উৎপন্ন বাগধারা
figurative_meaning_en: An idiom originating from the idea of giving three items to an enemy
similar_in_english: give the enemy an inch and he'll take a mile
example_sentences_in_bangla: কথায় বলে, শত্রুকে তিনশত্রু দিতে নাই, কারণ তা তার শক্তি বাড়িয়ে দেবে।
এই সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়ায় সে যেন তিনশত্রু দিয়ে ফেলল।
example_sentences_in_english: As the saying goes, one should not give three items to an enemy, as it would strengthen them.
By making that decision, he essentially gave three items to his enemy.
history: Originated from traditional Bengali wisdom advising against providing resources or items to enemies, possibly referring to specific three substances or tools that could be turned against the giver.
note: The specific 'three items' (দ্রব্য) are not detailed in the input, but imply objects that could empower or harm when given to foes.
